project_type: Greenfield browser game (Vite + TypeScript, canvas 2D, WebAudio) with a deterministic pure engine shared by an AWS CDK v2 backend Lambda (synth only) and a Node stdio MCP server. Repo currently holds only the scaffold commit 1ba18c1 (empty dirs with .gitkeep) plus the approved specs.
language: TypeScript 5.9.3 (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, ESNext modules, moduleResolution Bundler, verbatimModuleSyntax, resolveJsonModule, target ES2022)
build_system: Three npm packages with exact pins and committed lockfiles (.npmrc save-exact=true): repo root (game + ALL vitest tests incl. infra/lambda and mcp tool tests; type: module), infra/ (CDK app, tsx runner, local esbuild bundling, no DOM lib), mcp/arcade-operator/ (esbuild bundle to dist/index.js, then copied to retro-arcade-power/server/arcade-operator.mjs). Pinned versions in overview section 4.2. Node v22.22.1, npm 10.9.4 on this machine. If an exact pin is unpublished, use nearest published in the same major and update overview 4.2 + tech.md.
test_framework: vitest 5.0.3 + fast-check 4.10.2 (numRuns: PBT_RUNS = 200 from src/test-support/pbt.ts); Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium for headless screenshots; infra/test/stack.test.ts uses aws-cdk-lib/assertions
build_command: npm run build (tsc --noEmit && vite build); npm run build:mcp; npm run synth (cdk synth --quiet, never deploy)
test_command: npm test (vitest --run, root); npm run test:pbt; npm run typecheck; npm --prefix infra test; npm --prefix infra run typecheck; npm run verify:browser
verification_instructions: 1) npm test and npm run typecheck green after every FEAT. 2) Engine/arcade/leaderboard: targeted `npx vitest --run <dir>` then full npm test. 3) Presentation: npm run build exits 0. 4) Infra: npm --prefix infra test, npm --prefix infra run typecheck, `env -u AWS_PROFILE -u AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID -u AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY npm run synth` exits 0, npm run cfn-lint. 5) Tooling: npm run build:mcp, stdio tools/list smoke, npm run verify:browser producing 8 PNGs in docs/screenshots/. 6) Tick spec tasks.md checkboxes as tasks finish.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Committed generated files: package-lock.json (root, infra, mcp/arcade-operator); docs/screenshots/01..08-*.png and mcp/arcade-operator/data/{local-scores,sample-replay}.json (from npm run verify:browser); retro-arcade-power/server/arcade-operator.mjs (from npm run build:mcp); docs/cfn-lint-report.txt (npm run cfn-lint); docs/power-iac-validation.md (from the aws-infrastructure-as-code power tools). Gitignored: node_modules, dist, cdk.out, public/config.json.
environment_constraints: NEVER run cdk deploy (synth only, no real AWS). Never push; commit locally on main. uvx is available (cfn-lint, aws-docs MCP). Playwright needs `npx playwright install chromium` once. Port 4173 is used by vite preview for screenshots. Some in-Kiro checks (hook UI trigger names, steering inclusion, Powers panel install) may not be performable from an agent shell: attempt them, and record the outcome or the reason honestly in README.
contribution_requirements: Specs in .kiro/specs/ are the source of truth (overview sections 5-9 win over per-feature specs). Quality bar overview section 2: nothing stubbed, no TODO/FIXME/XXX/'not implemented' tokens, all 4 AIs, all 5 power-ups with timer+HUD+SFX, CRT + WebAudio, MCP 3 tools, power in both layouts, Playwright screenshots, complete README. Static guard S1 (tests/static/guard.test.ts) enforces forbidden APIs in pure dirs, engine import boundaries, TODO tokens, banned third-party game trademark names repo-wide (including .agents/ and .kiro/ - never write those names anywhere), no image/font assets under src/. No official AWS logos. Tick each spec tasks.md checkbox when that task is done. Commit per FEAT with Conventional Commit messages.
key_patterns: Pure deterministic engine: createGame(seed, config) / step(state, dir) mutating plain-JSON GameState; mulberry32 state in state.rng; integer fixed-point positions (TILE_UNITS 256); 60 ticks/s; events array cleared first each step and consumed by render/audio only; binding 11-phase playing step order (overview 5.8); ENEMY_ORDER and CATALOG_ORDER define iteration order; src/content/services.json is the single power-up catalog for engine, render and MCP. Cabinet is a pure reducer reduce(state, event) -> {state, effects}. Result<T,E> type in src/shared/result.ts. Adapters take injected fetch/Storage/AbortSignal/readFile for testability. Tests next to sources: *.test.ts and *.property.test.ts.
relevant_files: ../lesson1.md .. ../lesson7.md, ../bonus1.md, ../bonus2.md (course notes on Kiro file formats, read-only)
directory_structure: Target layout in overview section 4.3: src/{engine,engine/enemies,shared,arcade,leaderboard,content,render,render/screens,audio,app,test-support}, tests/static, scripts, infra/{bin,lib,lambda,test}, mcp/arcade-operator/{src,scripts,data}, retro-arcade-power/{steering,skills,server}, docs/screenshots, .kiro/{specs,steering,hooks,agents,settings}. .agents/tasks holds plan, reviews and FEAT artifacts (not product code).
